CSCO_1999.narrative: Networking backbone of the internet. Trading at extreme multiples on assumption of unlimited internet growth.
CSCO_1999.context: Dot-com peak. Essential infrastructure but priced for perfection.
CSCO_1999.outcome: Fell 85% by 2002. Took 17 years to reach new ATH. Business remained dominant but multiple collapsed.
CSCO_1999.lesson: Dominant business + extreme valuation = years of waiting even when fundamentals hold.

INTC_2000.narrative: Dominant chip designer riding PC boom. x86 monopoly.
INTC_2000.context: Seemingly unstoppable at peak hardware boom.
INTC_2000.outcome: Fell 80% by 2002. Lost mobile, lost foundry lead to TSMC. Still below 2000 peak in 2026.
INTC_2000.lesson: Dominance today doesn't protect against technology platform shifts.

MSFT_2000.narrative: OS monopoly with Office dominance. Facing DOJ antitrust.
MSFT_2000.context: Peak multiple just as PC growth began saturating.
MSFT_2000.outcome: Stock traded flat for 14 years. Nadella's cloud pivot required to break out.
MSFT_2000.lesson: Great businesses need new growth catalysts to grow into premium valuations.

AAPL_2008.narrative: iPhone launched 2007, App Store 2008. Platform shift underway but market panicking.
AAPL_2008.context: Crisis sell-off masked transformative platform launch.
AAPL_2008.outcome: Up 100x from 2009 low to 2024. iPhone became largest profit pool in consumer tech.
AAPL_2008.lesson: Crisis valuations on companies with new platform advantages create generational opportunities.

AMZN_2008.narrative: E-commerce growing through crisis. AWS launched 2006 but unrecognized.
AMZN_2008.context: Bezos's reinvestment seen as capital-destructive. Hidden cloud optionality.
AMZN_2008.outcome: AWS recognized by 2013, stock up 50x through 2021.
AMZN_2008.lesson: Hidden optionality in 'boring' businesses often undervalued during crises.

NFLX_2015.narrative: DVD to streaming transition, massive content spend, international launch.
NFLX_2015.context: Burning cash on content but subscriber growth justified optimism.
NFLX_2015.outcome: Up 5x to 2021, then 70% drawdown in 2022 on subscriber losses, recovered by 2024.
NFLX_2015.lesson: High-growth cash-burners work until competition arrives and growth slows.

TSLA_2019.narrative: Model 3 ramp, manufacturing hell, short-seller darling.
TSLA_2019.context: Just before sustained profitability. Wall Street largely rated Sell.
TSLA_2019.outcome: Up 20x through 2021, -75% drawdown, recovered. Still highly volatile.
TSLA_2019.lesson: Emerging-profitability stories can 10x+ once cash flow inflects, but volatility extreme.

NVDA_2016.narrative: GPU demand exploding from gaming, crypto, early AI. Deep learning papers using CUDA.
NVDA_2016.context: Investors still saw NVDA as gaming company. AI upside not priced.
NVDA_2016.outcome: Up 80x through 2024 AI boom. Became 3rd largest company in world.
NVDA_2016.lesson: Best product in emerging tech cycle often radically underestimated initially.

ZM_2020.narrative: Essential COVID infrastructure. Revenue grew 300%+. Priced as if WFH permanent.
ZM_2020.context: Became a verb during pandemic. Extreme growth rate deemed sustainable.
ZM_2020.outcome: Fell 90% from peak. Teams and Meet commoditized product.
ZM_2020.lesson: Pulled-forward demand reverts. Moats erode fast when product is easily copied.

META_2022.narrative: ATT crushed ad targeting. Reality Labs burning $10B+/yr. Investors rebelled.
META_2022.context: Priced as if core Facebook was dying. Worst sentiment in company history.
META_2022.outcome: Up 5x by 2024 on AI-driven ads recovery and cost cuts. Year of Efficiency.
META_2022.lesson: Durable businesses with fixable problems plus activist pressure recover faster than expected.

C_2008.narrative: Subprime losses mounting, capital ratio stressed, dividend cut.
C_2008.context: Seemingly cheap but actually overleveraged. Book value suspect.
C_2008.outcome: Fell 95% more through March 2009. Bailout. 1:10 reverse split.
C_2008.lesson: Cyclical financials with leverage problems can fall much further than P/E suggests.

JPM_2015.narrative: Post-crisis recovery complete, regulatory headwinds, flat NIM.
JPM_2015.context: Best-in-class bank at normal valuation. Boring but reliable.
JPM_2015.outcome: Compounded 12% annually through 2024. Dividend + buybacks + modest growth.
JPM_2015.lesson: Quality banks at normal valuations compound steadily without excitement.

BAC_2011.narrative: Countrywide legacy mortgages, fines, capital raises, Buffett warrants.
BAC_2011.context: Deeply discounted to book. Mortgage liability unclear.
BAC_2011.outcome: Up 5x through 2024 as legacy issues resolved and rates normalized.
BAC_2011.lesson: Post-crisis banks at deep discount to book reward patient investors.

PG_2018.narrative: Peltz activism, slow growth, premium brands under attack from DTC.
PG_2018.context: Quality defensive at reasonable multiple. Growth concerns overblown.
PG_2018.outcome: Up 80% through 2024 with steady dividend. Activist changes boosted execution.
PG_2018.lesson: Quality defensives at fair prices deliver steady real returns without excitement.

KO_2016.narrative: Declining soda volumes, refranchising bottlers, capex reduction.
KO_2016.outcome: Steady 8% annual total return through 2024. Buffett continued holding.
KO_2016.lesson: Iconic brands at fair valuations provide stable ballast even through volume declines.

COST_2015.narrative: Membership warehouse model. Slow growth but wide moat.
COST_2015.context: Premium multiple for 'boring' retailer. Membership economics dominant.
COST_2015.outcome: Up 4x through 2024. Premium multiple held and expanded.
COST_2015.lesson: Premium multiples are often justified by business model quality, not just growth rate.

NEE_2017.narrative: Largest US wind/solar operator. Growth utility vs traditional peers.
NEE_2017.context: Premium to sector on growth thesis. Rate-sensitive.
NEE_2017.outcome: Up 2x through 2021, then sharp decline as rates rose. Still best-in-class.
NEE_2017.lesson: Growth utilities work in low-rate environments but rate-sensitive on the downside.

XOM_2014.narrative: Dividend aristocrat at oil peak. $100 oil seen as floor.
XOM_2014.context: Saudi about to flood market to kill US shale. Glut forming.
XOM_2014.outcome: Oil to $26 by 2016. Stock -45% through 2020. Recovered on 2022 energy crisis.
XOM_2014.lesson: Commodity producers at cycle peaks with high dividend payouts often disappoint for years.

XOM_2020.narrative: Oil briefly negative, removed from Dow, dividend questioned.
XOM_2020.context: Deepest energy sector discount in a generation.
XOM_2020.outcome: Up 3x through 2024 as energy crisis and underinvestment hit supply.
XOM_2020.lesson: Deeply cyclical stocks at crisis lows with maintained capital discipline can 3-5x.

UNH_2012.narrative: Managed care leader, ACA uncertainty, Optum services scaling.
UNH_2012.context: Before the great managed care re-rating of 2013-2021.
UNH_2012.outcome: Up 12x through 2024. Best-performing Dow stock over that period.
UNH_2012.lesson: Quality compounders in stable industries with expanding moats can quietly deliver 10x+.

JNJ_2017.context: Quality multi-segment healthcare at reasonable multiple.
JNJ_2017.outcome: Mid-single-digit returns through 2024. Talc lawsuits weighed on stock.
JNJ_2017.lesson: Quality defensives can be hit by unexpected legal/regulatory events.

REGN_2011.narrative: Single-product biotech with Eylea ophthalmology launch.
REGN_2011.context: Transformational product launch. Cash burn but clear path to profitability.
REGN_2011.outcome: Up 15x through 2015 as Eylea ramped. Best biotech of the decade.
REGN_2011.lesson: Small biotechs with novel products in large markets can deliver 10-15x quickly.

CAT_2015.narrative: Mining equipment demand collapsed, China slowdown, dealer destocking.
CAT_2015.context: Deep cyclical at cycle trough. Management restructuring.
CAT_2015.outcome: Up 3x through 2024 on infrastructure spending and mining recovery.
CAT_2015.lesson: Deep cyclicals bought at cycle lows with quality management deliver big multi-year returns.

HD_2011.narrative: Post-housing-crisis recovery beginning. Big-box retail with improving margins.
HD_2011.context: Early innings of 10-year housing boom. Retail execution excellent.
HD_2011.outcome: Up 8x through 2021. Best-performing retail stock of the 2010s.
HD_2011.lesson: Early-cycle consumer cyclicals with strong execution can compound impressively.

F_2020.narrative: COVID auto demand crash, EV transition plans, Farley CEO arrival.
F_2020.context: Legacy auto at cycle bottom with credible turnaround.
F_2020.outcome: Up 3x through 2022, then gave back on EV execution concerns.
F_2020.lesson: Cyclical turnarounds in legacy industries produce sharp rallies followed by volatility.

PLD_2014.narrative: Industrial REIT benefiting from e-commerce logistics boom.
PLD_2014.context: Early recognition of logistics real estate secular trend.
PLD_2014.outcome: Up 4x through 2021 on unprecedented industrial rent growth.
PLD_2014.lesson: Sector-specialist REITs riding clear secular trends outperform broader REITs.

T_2017.narrative: Debt-heavy megamerger with Time Warner, 5G spectrum spending.
T_2017.context: High dividend yield trap. Structural wireline/media challenges.
T_2017.outcome: Stock -50% through 2022. Dividend cut. Warner Media spun off at loss.
T_2017.lesson: Dividend traps in declining businesses destroy wealth despite cheap multiples.

FCX_2020.narrative: Largest copper miner. EV transition tailwind unrecognized.
FCX_2020.context: Cyclical trough in copper. EV/renewables copper demand thesis nascent.
FCX_2020.outcome: Up 5x through 2022 on copper supercycle recognition.
FCX_2020.lesson: Commodity producers at cycle lows with clear secular tailwinds can 5x in 18 months.

CRM_2014.narrative: CRM category leader, expanding platform, still unprofitable on GAAP.
CRM_2014.context: Pre-cloud mainstream adoption. High-growth unprofitable SaaS.
CRM_2014.outcome: Up 10x through 2021, then compression on efficiency demands.
CRM_2014.lesson: Category-leading SaaS at 7-10x sales often rewards patience if growth maintained.

SHOP_2017.narrative: E-commerce platform for SMBs. Anti-Amazon narrative building.
SHOP_2017.context: Mid-cap hyper-growth SaaS. High valuation but explosive growth.
SHOP_2017.outcome: Up 15x through 2021, then -85% in 2022 correction. Recovered partially.
SHOP_2017.lesson: Hyper-growth mid-caps at high multiples produce both huge wins and huge volatility.

CSCO_1999.narrative: Lost 28% in 2000, then collapsed -85% by 2002 bottom. Multiple compression.

INTC_2000.narrative: Fell 27% in 2001, bottomed -75% in 2002. Never reached 2000 peak.

MSFT_2000.narrative: Fell 41% in 2000, traded sideways for 14 years until cloud pivot.

AAPL_2008.narrative: iPhone era. 145% in year 1, became most valuable company by 2014.

NFLX_2015.narrative: Slow first year. International scaled 2017-2018. 5x by 2020.

TSLA_2019.narrative: Profitability inflection. 740% in 2020. -75% drawdown 2022. Recovered partially.

NVDA_2016.narrative: AI emergence. 230% in 2017. Crypto crash 2018. AI boom 2020-2024.

ZM_2020.narrative: Peak COVID overdone. Fell 45% year 1, then -90% as competition arrived.

META_2022.narrative: Year of Efficiency. 195% in 2023. AI ads recovery. New ATH 2024.

C_2008.narrative: Collapsed -88% to bailout. Reverse split. Never recovered to 2007 levels.

BAC_2011.narrative: Bottomed late 2011. 5x by 2024 as legacy issues resolved.

COST_2015.narrative: Quality compounder. Premium multiple held. ~15% annual.

NEE_2017.narrative: Renewable transition story. Doubled by 2021, then rate-driven decline.

XOM_2014.narrative: Oil collapse. Stock fell with crude. Recovered post-2022 only.

XOM_2020.narrative: COVID bottom. Energy crisis 2022. 3x in 18 months.

JNJ_2017.narrative: Mid-single digit returns. Talc litigation overhang.

REGN_2011.narrative: Eylea launch. Best biotech of decade. 10x by 2015.

CAT_2015.narrative: Bottomed 2016. Trump infrastructure rally. Recovered to 3x by 2024.

HD_2011.narrative: Housing recovery. Best retailer of 2010s. 8x by 2021.

F_2020.narrative: EV pivot rally. -75% drawdown 2022 on execution doubts.
